ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION I. Title 17 of the Municipal Code, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, be
amended by changing all the RT-4 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-
Unit District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 7-G in the area bounded
by:
A public alley next north of and parallel to West Fullerton Avenue; a line
198.3 feet west of and parallel to North Seminary Avenue; West Fullerton

Avenue: and a line 223.3 feet west of and parallel to North Seminary
Avenue;

to those of a B3-2 Community Shopping District.
SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and

due publication.

Common Address of Property: 1120 West Fullerton Avenue
